title: Iteration of the multiplication step
statement: For any bit strings $b,\mathrm{acc}$ and natural number $j$, applying the multiplication step $j$ times to $\langle b,\mathrm{acc}\rangle$ gives the pair encoding of $b$ and the concatenation of $\mathrm{acc}$ with $j$ copies of $b$.
